source: Kartverket NHM DOM-DTM canopy height model, treetops by local maxima + gap fill
fields: id, x, y (local m), z (ground, m asl), h (height m), crown (radius m), species, rot (rad), tint, cleared
instancing: three.js: position (x, z, -y); scale (crown, h, crown) on the unit template; rotateY(rot)
clearing_note: cleared = inside parcel 355/10, on the hill (y > -95 m local), more than 10 m from the boundary.
note: cleared = within 14 m of a house centre, 6.5 m of the road centreline or 2.5 m of the footpath, or standing in a living room's line of sight to the water it sees (layout v6, four rows); the rest of the forest stays
